open_findings.finding: CheckedCallback hashes the source file currently on disk and checks supplied function qualname/source filename, but does not establish that the loaded function code was compiled from those pinned bytes. A normally imported stale function can pass after the file is updated when the request pins the new file SHA. A replacement code object using the same filename/name also passes. Thus exact loaded callable source closure is not enforced.
open_findings.suggestion: Bind actual compiled function code to the pinned bytes via a reviewed fresh-source loader or static compiled-code equivalence check; retain explicit trusted callback/dependency/global-state limits. Add a new stale-loaded-function negative fixture. Filename/qualname alone is not a code identity.
